description: Image Description: The image shows a collection of six surfboards leaning vertically against a white wall, secured by black horizontal bars mounted at the top and bottom. The surfboards are arranged in a row from left to right, each with distinct colors and designs. Starting from the left, the first board is light yellow with visible wear and graffiti-like markings, including a small green sticker near the top. Next to it is a slightly smaller, off-white board with a subtle design and a red flag decal
